# Meeting & Roadshow Minutes

<!-- nav:start (generated by scripts/gen_nav_headers.py; do not edit by hand) -->
> **Sections**: Audience Adaptation · Input Contract · Workflow · Quality Gates · Handoffs
> **Formats**: document_standards.md
<!-- nav:end -->

Convert recordings/transcripts of buyer meetings, roadshows, or conference calls into structured minutes and key quotations. This task handles **existing materials**; it is the opposite of pre-meeting preparation tasks (`management-meeting-questions`, `expert-call-guide`).

## Audience Adaptation

This task often originates from non-institutional contexts (founders organizing roadshow recordings, individuals organizing call notes). Adjust format and depth according to `presentation.audience`; pure transcription requests (no sensitive flags, no external distribution) retain `governance_tier: light` status and do not require loading plugin-specific professional formats. Recordings, transcripts, and contact information are sensitive; when `confidential_material` is triggered, load [`privacy-security.md`](../../../privacy-security.md).

## Input Contract

| Field | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `subject` | Required | Name of the meeting or roadshow |
| `source_files` | Required and potentially sensitive | Recordings, transcripts, or shorthand drafts |
| `audience` | Optional | Internal team, IC, management, or individual |

## Workflow

1. Preserve speaker labels, timestamps, and uncertain transcript markers.
2. Normalize technical terms and company/product names; mark items that cannot be confirmed.
3. Separate established facts, forward-looking statements, commitments, questions, and action items.
4. Extract key quotations only when supported by original evidence; do not fabricate verbatim quotes.

## Quality Gates

| Gate | Passing Criteria | Failure Handling |
|---|---|---|
| Quotations verifiable | Can be returned to the recording/transcript location | Convert to a summary instead of a quotation |
| Markers preserved | Uncertain content remains marked | Do not silently fill in |
| Publication authorization | Verify audience, confidentiality, and copyright prior to external distribution | Keep as draft; do not publish |

## Handoffs

- Commitments and action items in the minutes can be transferred to `dd-tracker` for tracking.
- When research conclusions need to be derived from the minutes, escalate upstream to `equity-research`; do not generate investment opinions directly from the minutes.
- Result object `payload.task_id = meeting-minutes`.
